# Shinesty

> > Shinesty is a Boulder, Colorado-based e-commerce brand specializing in dangerously comfortable underwear, swimwear, and novelty apparel featuring innovative pouch technology and premium fabric blends.

Shinesty offers a curated collection of men's and women's intimate apparel, swimwear, and themed clothing with signature Ball Hammock pouch technology and micromodal fabrics. The brand is known for bold collaborations with lifestyle brands like Margaritaville and Realtree, as well as innovative features like fart-proof underwear technology.

## Key Topics

- Ball Hammock Pouch
- Micromodal Fabric
- Odor Control Technology
- Men's Underwear
- Boxer Briefs
- Swimwear
- Modal Fabric
- SleepDeep™ Pajamas
- Subscription Service
- Fart-Proof Underwear
- Brand Collaborations
- Novelty Apparel
- Quick-Dry Technology
- Livinguard Technologies

## Signature Collections

- [Shinesty | Dangerously Comfortable Underwear and Apparel](https://www.shinesty.com): Shinesty homepage showcasing outrageous party clothing, Ball Hammock underwear, and themed apparel collections.
- [The Best Men's Pouch Underwear: Ball Hammocks® by Shinesty](https://www.shinesty.com/collections/all-mens-underwear): Complete Ball Hammock® pouch underwear collection for men with odor control.
- [All Boxer Briefs](https://www.shinesty.com/collections/all-boxer-briefs): Shinesty boxer briefs collection with Ball Hammock pouch and cooling fabric.
- [The SleepDeep™ Collection | Super, Stupid-Soft™ Comfort Essentials](https://www.shinesty.com/collections/sleepdeep-pajamas-for-men-and-women): SleepDeep™ pajama collection featuring micromodal fabric for men and women sleepwear.
- [Printed Swimsuits & Swim Trunks by Shinesty](https://www.shinesty.com/collections/printed-bathing-suits): Printed swimwear collection for men and women with Ball Hammock pouch and quick-dry fabric.
- [Shinesty Fart-Proof Underwear](https://www.shinesty.com/lp/fart-proof-underwear): Fart-proof underwear with Livinguard Technologies odor-blocking electrostatic technology.
